resolvedReviewFindings.original: Archive provider validation used issuance only, permitting evidence expired before the signed decision.
resolvedReviewFindings.independentRecheck: Original-decision validity enforced; expired provider pack refuses; valid complete provider pack verifies.

resolvedReviewFindings.original: The private application could invent an approval proposal against an allowed but invalid actual model completion.
resolvedReviewFindings.independentRecheck: Actual gateway-accepted completion digest and independently parsed proposal must match the released artifact and acceptance flag. Original invented-approval repro and 10 independent release-response probes pass at the frozen private source.

executionReview: All new attestation/provider executions remain software. Valid test-vendor fixture returns software/testOnly; real hardware/device claims refuse. Existing15quote standard tests cover pinned root/key/measurement/fresh challenge/result signature and retained-journal replay. No real vendor verifier built.

cases: Concurrent same send request produces only one reviewed token and reservation.
Concurrent distinct approvals recheck cumulative cap under final transaction.

privateRuntimeReview.limits: Signed software evidence trusts provider host. Raw model text deliberately not retained; offline audit uses recorded commitment/hash and tested release binding. No successful model recommendation or hardware claim.

optionalReviewGate.localControls: Hard thresholds/stop/quarantine/limits before provider; immutable request; signed policy hash and current state rechecked after await; evidence/expiry in token; consume/signing barrier checks; no human-approval implementation or provider override.
optionalReviewGate.entryPoints: CLI and localhost API use awaited authorizeReviewed; config injects optional environment provider.
optionalReviewGate.testIdentityScope: Policy/gate/agent are internally verified ephemeral demo identities, not independently pinned operational-wallet identities.

independentDependencies: Separate branches/worktrees and isolated installed dependencies for both repositories; no parent-root dependency symlinks.
scope: Independent code/security review and replay of signed final live evidence. QA wrote probes/reports only; runtime implementation and actual launcher/application execution were performed by the integration owner.

hygiene.historyProviderMentionsTextOnly: Historical attribution/QA prose retained in 5 file paths; explicit README exception, no history rewrite.

limitations: Every live result is signed software execution under a trusted provider host; no real hardware quote or TEE proof.
Both actual model proposals were invalid and rejected. Fixed code conservatively returned review/escalate; no accepted live model approval is claimed.

The incoming proof re-screens the earlier confirmed testnet receive. The actual action-review provider reviewed a synthetic unsigned send. No new transfer, signing token consumption or wallet broadcast occurred.
Receiver consignment bytes were hashed locally and only their digest disclosed. Full RGB consignment/ancestry verification and pattern completeness are not established.
Raw model responses are intentionally not retained. Offline QA checks recorded commitments/hashes and audited tested source release binding rather than replaying raw text.
Operational provider URL/pins, full request/envelope, private contracts/runtime records and commitment openings remain outside Git. Audit ZIP stays private.

Historical provider-name attribution/QA prose remains in old commits. Current tip confines the named provider to README; the full ancestry/dependency audit found no provider runtime/package/operational endpoint/key.
Device/provider quorum verification remains designed; flagged-list remote API is a stub; Settle, Remember and a real human approval workflow are not built.
Audit pack proves specified cryptographic records and bindings, not statutory compliance certification.
